mapper.select: SELECT genre_character_group_id, user_id, user_id, name, created_at, updated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM genre_character_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY genre_character_group_id
mapper.update: UPDATE genre_character_group SET name = #{name} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND genre_character_group_id = #{genreCharacterGroupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM genre_character_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND genre_character_group_id = #{genreCharacterGroupId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.genre_character_id FROM genre_character c JOIN genre_character_group p ON p.genre_character_group_id = c.genre_character_group_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name = #{defaultName} AND c.name = #{defaultName}
